cast.name: 阿玛莉亚·乌伊斯 Amalia Uys

introduction: Paul Mullan has left the police force after mistakenly killing his partner. He became a drifter. Accidentally he lands a job as a chauffeur after meeting a mysterious wealthy gentleman named Bernhard. Soon he gets involved with in a passionate love affair with Bernhard’s lover, Michelle. Things start getting complicated for everybody when Bernhard’s daughter, Lindsey, gets kidnapped.  Trying to not involve the police, Bernhard asks Paul and Michelle to help rescue Lindsey. They managed to do it but they also discover that Lindsey wasn’t so innocent after all.Based on Best Selling Book "Double Echo" by Francois Bloemhof
